visa_types.visa_type_name: Short-stay (Schengen) visa - Type C / visa de court séjour
visa_types.notes: Uniform Schengen visa for stays up to 90 days in any 180-day period; used for tourism, short business trips, family visits.

visa_types.visa_type_name: Long-stay visa - Type D (visa de long séjour / VLS-TS)
visa_types.notes: General national long-stay visa category (over 90 days), taking different 'mention' sub-types depending on purpose (salarié, visiteur, étudiant, etc.). Listed here under work since the salaried-employment page confirms this category.

visa_types.visa_type_name: Salaried employment long-stay visa (salarié / travailleur temporaire)
visa_types.notes: For foreign nationals recruited by a French employer on fixed or indefinite contract, or as a temporary/seasonal worker.

visa_types.visa_type_name: ICT (Intra-Corporate Transferee) posted employee / trainee visa
visa_types.notes: 'Salarié détaché ICT' and 'stagiaire ICT' mentions for intra-group mobility transfers and trainees, confirmed on the France-Visas salaried activity page.

visa_types.visa_type_name: Self-employed / liberal profession long-stay visa (activité non salariée ou libérale)
visa_types.notes: For those wishing to run a self-employed or liberal-profession activity in France.
Multi-category visa/residence permit for highly skilled workers, entrepreneurs, investors, and other qualifying 'international talents'; includes EU Blue Card sub-category per secondary sources.

Sub-category of Talent Passport for Master's-degree holders conducting research or university teaching under a hosting agreement; confirmed on Campus France (official partner site referencing france-visas.gouv.fr).

visa_types.visa_type_name: Talent Passport - Family accompanying visa (Talent - Famille)
visa_types.notes: Spouses/children of Talent Passport holders apply for a visa marked 'Talent – Famille' via France-Visas; found referenced by multiple sources describing France-Visas procedure but no single official France-Visas URL was pinned down in this search.
For Bachelor's and Master's level study; Campus France is the official partner platform of France-Visas for student visa applications.
For doing an internship in France as part of an enrolled program abroad.
Referenced on Campus France page ('the student visa short stay') for study-related stays under 90 days; specific France-Visas URL not confirmed in this search.

Mentioned repeatedly on official France-Visas Brexit and volunteering pages (e.g. VLS-T/VLS-TS 'Visiteur') for stays without work authorization living on own resources; a dedicated single official page URL was not isolated in this search, though the mention is confirmed across multiple France-Visas pages such as france-visas.gouv.fr/en/brexit.
For family members joining a foreign national already legally residing in France, processed via OFII and the prefecture.

visa_types.visa_type_name: Spouse of French national long-stay visa (conjoint de Français)
visa_types.notes: Confirmed as a distinct visa mention ('conjoint de Français') on the official France-Visas Brexit guidance page listing visa categories.

visa_types.visa_type_name: Family member of an EU/EEA citizen visa (famille de citoyen européen)
visa_types.notes: For family members (spouse, direct descendants, etc.) of EU/EEA citizens residing in or moving to France.
For internationally adopted children joining their adoptive family in France.
Covers European Voluntary Service ('Volontaire') and other volunteering stays, with visa mention varying by duration.

visa_types.visa_type_name: Business travel visa (venir en France pour affaires)
visa_types.notes: Covers coming to France for business/commercial relations under the 'Travailler en France' professional-motive page, which enumerates business, ICT mobility, employment, and internship pathways.
